Axiom:
Deterministic mechanical checks are NOT hand-coded in this directive — they live in one tool, `sdd-check`, which the whole-tree reporter and this directive both consume. Single source of mechanical truth → no drift between the SDD reviewers. Take its findings as given; do NOT hand-redo them.
- `sdd-check --task ` → one ticket: section-anchor balance · Meta + Execution Log present · Task-ID / Status parseable (**SDD_TASK_ID_GRAMMAR** on v2 ticket names) · fabricated DONE · DONE-with-active-blocker · DONE-with-placeholders · phase graph (deps resolve + acyclic) · phase ↔ `PHASE_Pn` section coverage · DONE ⇒ every phase checked · **RULES_CASCADE_CLOSURE** (each phase's `Rules:` list is already the full transitive `` closure — `SDD_RULES_CASCADE_UNRESOLVED`) · **BDD_COVERAGE** (Test Scenario Coverage canonical case names exist verbatim in their declared test file — `SDD_BDD_SCENARIO_UNTESTED`) · **BDD_NEGATIVE** (every v2 ticket declares at least one explicit negative/failure scenario — `SDD_BDD_MISSING_NEGATIVE`) · **BDD_TRACE** (each scenario's Requirement-ID appears in its coverage row and the real test name — `SDD_BDD_REQUIREMENT_UNTRACED`) · **COVERAGE_POLICY** (`COVERAGE_POLICY:v1` binds one test Coverage Owner Phase to one Role=coverage reader — `SDD_COVERAGE_POLICY_INVALID` / `SDD_COVERAGE_OWNER_INVALID` / `SDD_COVERAGE_READER_OWNER_MISMATCH` / `SDD_COVERAGE_READER_RERUNS_PRODUCER`) · **PHASE_RECEIPT** (a `PHASE_RECEIPTS:v1` ticket's checked phases carry current CLI-owned evidence — `SDD_PHASE_RECEIPT_INCOMPLETE` / `SDD_PHASE_RECEIPT_INVALID`). - `sdd-check --all [root]` → the whole tree, additionally: the task DAG (Task-ID collisions · unresolved dependencies · cycles) · tracker ↔ ticket coherence (status drift · missing rows · orphan rows) · spec-link resolution + spec-anchor balance · portal integrity (scope-graph acyclicity · graph↔table↔spec · orphan specs · dangling deps) · **group receipts** (every fully-DONE ticket group of one spec carries a durable `audit-receipt` / `review-receipt` — `SDD_GROUP_AUDIT_MISSING` / `SDD_GROUP_REVIEW_MISSING`) — plus RULES_CASCADE_CLOSURE, BDD_COVERAGE, BDD_NEGATIVE, BDD_TRACE, COVERAGE_POLICY and PHASE_RECEIPT per ticket, as above. - `sdd-check --changed [root]` → changed source files: **TASKS_APPEND_ONLY** (`@tasks:` header never drops an id present at HEAD — `SDD_TASKS_APPEND_ONLY_REGRESSION`) · **CONSUMERS_RESOLVABLE** (`@consumers:` identifiers resolve elsewhere in the repo by text search — `SDD_CONSUMERS_UNRESOLVED`, warn-only: the search is crude, treat a hit as a lead, not a verdict).
`gennady yagni` (run as part of `sdd-verify --profile full`, STEP_1) is likewise taken as given for its own two checks: usage count `< 2` (`ERR_CLI_YAGNI_UNDERUSED`) and, when the Usage Waiver label cites an `-DL-N` (or immutable legacy id), whether it resolves to a live Decision Log entry (`ERR_CLI_YAGNI_WAIVER_DECISION_MISSING`) — do not re-count usages or re-search Decision Logs by hand.
Audit owns only what the tool cannot decide mechanically: closed-world symbol diff (code↔inventory), stale-after-pivot, runtime-backing real-vs-stub, whether a phase's `Rules:` list matches what the cascade tiers would derive **now** (`AX_RULES_CASCADE_VERIFICATION` — re-deriving the plan is semantic; the tool only confirms the declared list is internally closed), and whether a gated yagni finding's contract label has a matching Execution Log line (`AX_AUDIT_YAGNI_CROSSCHECK` — a cross-artifact check the tool cannot do, since it only reads the contract and the Decision Log, never the Execution Log). File-header presence (`@file`/`@consumers`/`@tasks`) is checked by `sdd-verify`, not here.
